item: G2-05 (S10-2 heritage creditRate info button white-on-white)
cause: Port-authored JP-localization rule in candidate-input.css: #page-content .creditRate.creditModule .creditButton {background:none} (absent upstream). The button renders as an empty bordered box in the S10 heritage module frame (W11/W13 frame e855e732fdae..., module crop verified): the info glyph does not read against the module ground.
correction: #page-content .creditRate.creditModule .creditButton{background-color:#333} + anchor color #fff (the theme's own dark accent, matching its action buttons).
finding: Post-fix frame: the credit button renders as a dark box with a white info glyph beside the heritage rate widget — readable. Before frame: empty bordered box (glyph invisible).
